name: Night Gallery
about_text: Night Gallery is a contemporary art gallery based in the Arts District of Los Angeles, at 2050 Imperial Street. Led by owner Davida Nemeroff, the gallery represents an international roster of emerging and mid-career artists working across painting, sculpture, and installation. Its program includes solo and group exhibitions, publications, and an active presence at major international art fairs such as Frieze, Art Basel Miami Beach, The Armory Show, and NADA. Night Gallery artists have received extensive press coverage in outlets including The New York Times, Artforum, Frieze, and Hyperallergic, and its exhibitions frequently travel to museums and institutions worldwide.
